description: This file defines data structures and function prototypes for managing average values in a table, likely used for engine control or similar purposes. It includes structure definitions, constants, and function declarations related to manipulating average value tables based on RPM and other keys.

methods.name: avgReset
methods.description: Resets the given AvgTable, clearing stored values and counts.

methods.name: avgFill
methods.description: Fills the AvgTable with a specified count and value.

methods.name: avgAddValue
methods.description: Adds a value associated with a specific RPM and key to the AvgTable.

methods.name: avgGetValueByIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the AvgTable based on array indexes.

methods.name: avgGetValue
methods.description: Gets the average value for a given RPM and key.

methods.name: avgGetValuesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of values for a specific RPM and key.
